name: unicode_tools
description: Inspect and normalise Unicode text with the standard library's unicodedata: NFC, NFD, NFKC and NFKD with their code points, accent stripping, each character's code point, name, general category and script, UTF-8, UTF-16 and UTF-32 bytes in hex and decoding hex back to text, and a homoglyph check that flags words mixing Latin, Cyrillic and Greek or made only of Latin lookalikes, using pairs from Unicode TR39 confusables.txt. Reports the Unicode version of unicodedata.

text.description: The text; every operation except decode

hex.description: decode: bytes in hex, e.g. "C3 A9"

catalog.source: Python stdlib unicodedata (UAX #15 normalisation, UnicodeData.txt names and categories); homoglyph pairs from Unicode TR39 confusables.txt 18.0.0 (Unicode License v3)
